tagline: Industrial control ki simple, bharosa karne wali language.
description: Modbus se control computer ek PLC se numbers padh sakta hai aur outputs on kar sakta hai: registers 16-bit values rakhte hain, coils on/off switches hote hain. Modbus/TCP har request ko 7-byte MBAP header mein wrap karke port 502 par bhejta hai. Ismein authentication nahi hai, isliye iske aas-paas ke network ko ise protect karna padta hai.
facts: Built-in kuch nahi; Modbus Security TLS jodta hai

normal.name: Tank ka level padho aur pump start karo
normal.summary: HMI teen holding registers poll karta hai, phir pump start karne ke liye ek coil write karta hai.

steps.title: Port 502 se connect karo
steps.desc: HMI PLC se TCP connection kholta hai
steps.detail: Water plant ki SCADA screen (HMI) ek tank ka level dikhati hai aur operator ko pump chalane deti hai. Tank ko ek PLC control karta hai, ek rugged industrial computer jo sensor aur pump se juda hai. HMI PLC se port 502, yaani Modbus/TCP port, par TCP connection kholta hai.

steps.title: Read Holding Registers
steps.detail: Modbus 16-bit registers mein sochta hai. HMI address 0 (jise manuals 40001 kehte hain) se shuru hoke 3 holding registers maangta hai. Request ke aage 7-byte MBAP header hai: transaction ID 1, protocol 0, length 6 (unit ID + 5 PDU bytes) aur unit ID 1.

quiz.q: PDU hai function code (1) + start address (2) + quantity (2). MBAP Length field mein kya jaata hai?
quiz.why: Length uske baad ke har byte ko count karta hai: 1-byte unit ID plus 5-byte PDU = 6.

steps.title: Registers wapas aate hain
steps.detail: PLC wahi transaction ID, function 3, byte count 6 aur teen big-endian values ke saath jawab deta hai: 0x02E6 = 742 cm, 0x026A = 618 (61.8%) aur alarm setpoint 1100. Modbus nahi batata ki number ka matlab kya hai. Sirf PLC ka register map, ek document, batata hai ki register 40002 percent ke tenths mein hai.

quiz.q: Ek register mein bytes 02 E6 hain. Woh kaunsa number hai?

steps.title: Write Single Coil
steps.detail: Operator Start Pump click karta hai. Coil ek single on/off output hai. HMI coil address 0 par value 0xFF00 ke saath function 5 bhejta hai, jiska matlab ON hai (0x0000 matlab OFF; koi aur value illegal hai). PLC apna output switch karta hai aur confirmation ke taur par request ko echo karta hai.

quiz.q: Successful Write Single Coil response kaisa dikhta hai?
quiz.why: Function 5 ke liye PLC wahi address aur value repeat karta hai jo usne likhi. Wahi echo confirmation hai.

steps.title: Polling jaari rakho
steps.desc: HMI har second dobara padhta hai
steps.detail: Modbus mein push nahi hota: PLC tab tak kabhi nahi bolta jab tak poocha na jaye. Isliye HMI poll karta hai, har second naye transaction ID ke saath wahi registers padhta hai. Level badhkar 745 cm ho gaya hai. Yeh steady request-response rhythm normal Modbus traffic jaisa dikhta hai, aur isse ajeeb writes pakadna aasan ho jaata hai.

outro.title: Pump chal raha hai
outro.text: HMI ne tank level ko raw 16-bit registers ki tarah padha, function 5 aur 0xFF00 se pump on kiya, aur polling jaari rakhi. Har message ek chhota MBAP header plus kuch bytes ka PDU tha.
facts: Client poll karta hai, PLC jawab deta hai

exception.name: Exception: illegal data address
exception.summary: Aise registers ki request jo PLC ke paas nahi hain, function 0x83, code 2 lautati hai.

steps.title: Missing register maango
steps.detail: Ek engineer nayi screen jodta hai lekin address galat PLC manual se copy kar leta hai: register 40257 (address 256). Is PLC mein sirf 64 holding registers hain. Request khud bilkul well formed hai.

steps.title: Exception response
steps.detail: PLC function code plus 0x80 se jawab deta hai: 3 ban jaata hai 0x83. Woh top bit ka matlab hai "yeh error hai". Uske baad ka ek byte exception code hai: 2, Illegal Data Address. HMI nayi screen par value ke bajaye laal question mark dikhata hai.

quiz.q: Write Single Coil (function 5) fail hota hai. Kaunsa function code wapas aata hai?
quiz.why: Exceptions top bit set karte hain: 0x05 | 0x80 = 0x85.

outro.title: Exception handle ho gaya
outro.text: Modbus errors function code ke roop mein wapas aate hain jiska top bit set hota hai, plus ek-byte exception code. Code 2 ka matlab hai address range is device par nahi hai.
facts: 1 bad function, 3 bad value, 4 device failure

unauth-write.name: Office network se unauthenticated write
unauth-write.summary: Malware pump start kar deta hai kyunki Modbus mein login nahi hai; segmentation aur Modbus Security ise rokte hain.

steps.title: Koi bhi connect kar sakta hai
steps.desc: Firewall kisi bhi office PC ko 502 tak pahunchne deta hai
steps.detail: Ek office PC malware se infected hai. Office (IT) network aur plant (OT) network ke beech firewall mein purana "allow any" rule hai, isliye malware port 502 par PLC tak pahunch jaata hai. Modbus mein login, password aur encryption kuch nahi hai. PLC connection ko kisi bhi aur ki tarah accept kar leta hai.

steps.title: Coil likhi gayi, koi sawal nahi
steps.desc: Tank pehle se high hai; phir bhi pump start ho jaata hai
steps.detail: Malware bilkul wahi Write Single Coil bhejta hai jo HMI use karta hai: coil 0, 0xFF00. PLC ko pata nahi chalta ki kisne bheja aur woh bas maan leta hai. Agar PLC logic mein independent high-level interlock nahi hai, to tank overflow ho sakta hai. Packet mein kuch unusual nahi; sirf uska source unusual hai.
facts: Sender ke baare mein kuch nahi

quiz.q: Standard Modbus/TCP PLC kaise tay karta hai ki write accept karna hai ya nahi?
options: Woh MBAP header mein password check karta hai
Woh sender ka certificate check karta hai
Woh tay nahi karta: har well-formed request execute hoti hai
Woh pehle HMI se poochta hai
quiz.why: Classic Modbus mein authentication bilkul nahi hai. Protection aas-paas ke network se, ya Modbus Security se aani chahiye.

steps.title: Defence: segment aur filter
steps.desc: Sirf HMI port 502 se baat kar sakta hai
steps.detail: Plant firewall theek karta hai: sirf HMI ka address 502 par PLC tak pahunch sakta hai, aur office network alag zone hai (IEC 62443 ka zones-and-conduits idea). Malware ka agla SYN firewall par drop ho jaata hai aur PLC tak kabhi nahi pahunchta. Kai sites Modbus-aware firewall bhi lagate hain jo HMI ke alawa kisi se bhi write function codes block karta hai.
facts: Deep packet inspection: fc 5/6/15/16 block karo

steps.title: 802 par Modbus Security
steps.detail: Naye PLCs Modbus/TCP Security support karte hain: wahi Modbus messages port 802 par mutual TLS ke andar. Dono sides X.509 certificates dikhati hain, aur HMI ke certificate mein "Operator" jaisa role hota hai jise PLC write allow karne se pehle check karta hai. TLS handshake (yahan nahi dikhaya) ke baad 12-byte write 29-byte encrypted record ki tarah travel karta hai.

quiz.q: Port 802 par Modbus Security aisa kya jodta hai jo port 502 ke plain Modbus mein nahi hai?
quiz.why: TLS encryption deta hai aur prove karta hai ki har side kaun hai; certificate ka role tay karta hai ki woh client kya kar sakta hai.

outro.title: Network ko protect karo, sirf PLC ko nahi
outro.text: Plain Modbus har packet par bharosa karta hai, isliye jo bhi device port 502 tak pahunch sake woh plant control kar sakta hai. IT aur OT networks alag karo, sirf HMI ko andar aane do, function codes inspect karo, aur jahan devices support karein wahan certificates ke saath Modbus Security par jao.

cheatsheet.title: MBAP header (7 bytes)
items: 2 bytes, reply mein echo hota hai
1 byte, gateway ke peeche ka device
